previous.changeLog: fixed a double hit sound that could occur on a single shot

current.changeLog: Reworked Hitmarker Pro (the marker and sound now appear only when you damage an enemy: a hit, fire or kill, each in its own colour. Simpler, and the sound is now instant and reliable on fast-firing guns like autocannons)

previous.changeLog: Scheduled Personal Reserves now remain scheduled when switching servers. Switching accounts cancels the previous account’s schedule and displays a notification.

current.changeLog: Added click-to-toggle scheduling and support for scheduling alternate booster tiers during battle. Schedulable cards now use a cleaner enabled appearance, with scheduled variants clearly marked by plasma effects.
